meta.name: doc-coauthoring
meta.description: Guide users through a structured workflow for co-authoring documentation. Use when user wants to write documentation, proposals, technical specs, decision docs, or similar structured content. This workflow helps users efficiently transfer context, refine content through iteration, and verify the doc works for readers. Trigger when user mentions writing docs, creating proposals, drafting specs, or similar documentation tasks.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 按结构化流程协作撰写文档
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要与他人协作撰写结构化的文档或提案
copy.tagline_en: Collaborate on structured documentation with a guided workflow
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to co-author structured documents or proposals with others

howto.what: Claude 会按三阶段带你写文档：先问清文档类型、读者、格式等信息并收集素材；再逐节讨论与修改，产出完整正文；最后用全新 Claude 会话试读，修正难懂处。
howto.when: 当你说要写文档或提案，或提到 PRD 这类文档类型时，Claude 会提出用这套流程协作；如果你拒绝，就自由写作。

say.text: 我要写一份技术方案，用协作流程帮我起草。
say.note: 会先问你文档类型、读者与模板要求。

say.text: 帮我写一份 PRD，按你的流程来。
say.note: 会要求你先倾倒背景，再追问澄清。

say.text: 写一份决策文档，写完后做一次读者测试。
say.note: 会用新的 Claude 会话验证是否易懂。

howto.what_en: Claude will lead a 3-stage co-authoring workflow: clarify context, build and refine each section, then test the result with a fresh Claude to catch blind spots.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to write docs or proposals, or mentions doc types like PRD. If the user declines, Claude writes freeform.

say_en.text: Draft a technical spec using your co-authoring workflow.
say_en.note: Claude first asks about doc type, audience, and template.

say_en.text: Write a PRD following your process.
say_en.note: Claude invites a context dump, then asks clarifying questions.

say_en.text: Write a decision doc, then do reader testing.
say_en.note: A fresh Claude session checks whether it is easy to understand.
